view_frame: The primary view is TOP (XY plane), showing the handle's footprint. The Z axis represents height (vertical in the physical part). The END SECTION view shows the circular cross-section perpendicular to the path. The part is a U-shaped handle lying flat in the XY plane.

features.placement: The path consists of two straight segments and one semicircular arc in the XY plane. The arc is centered at (0, 30) with radius 20 mm, spanning from angle 0 to 180 degrees (counter-clockwise). The right straight leg runs from (20, 30) to (20, 0). The left straight leg runs from (-20, 30) to (-20, 0). The section is a circle of diameter 8 mm, centered on the path.
features.evidence: Top view shows a U-shape. Text annotation 'Bend centreline R20; straight legs 30 mm'. End section view shows a circle with text 'diameter 8 mm'.

connections: The straight legs are tangent to the semicircular arc at the junction points (±20, 30).
edit_rules: Changing the section diameter updates the sweep profile radius.
Changing the bend centreline radius updates the arc geometry and the start/end points of the straight legs.
Changing the straight leg length updates the end coordinates of the straight segments.
